calculation.supported_scope: Ordinary Florida money judgments governed by Fla. Stat. §55.03, obtained on or after July 1, 2011, using the statutory CFO schedule with no payment events.
excluded_branches: A rate established by written contract or obligation
Clerk-entered judgments under Fla. Stat. §§55.141, 61.14, 938.29, or 938.30
Prejudgment interest, partial payments, later-added fees or costs, renewals, amended judgments, and account-specific allocations

branches.general: Fla. Stat. §55.03(1): the CFO sets a quarterly annual rate from the preceding 12-month New York Fed discount-rate average plus four percentage points
branches.rate_adjustment: §55.03(3): use the rate in effect when judgment is obtained, then adjust annually each January 1 until paid
branches.written_contract: §55.03(1): the statutory schedule does not affect an interest rate established by written contract or obligation
branches.clerk_judgments: §55.03(3): judgments entered by the clerk under §§55.141, 61.14, 938.29, and 938.30 do not receive the annual January 1 adjustment

annual_rate.notes: The Florida CFO publishes 8.06% for the quarter beginning July 1, 2026 under Fla. Stat. §55.03. The statutory rate is selected when judgment is obtained and then adjusts each January 1 to the CFO rate then in effect until paid. A written contract or obligation can establish its own rate, and clerk-entered judgments under §§55.141, 61.14, 938.29, and 938.30 do not receive the annual adjustment. The official table also supplies daily factors and every distinct period since October 1, 1981. Verify the correct branch; not legal advice.

The Florida CFO publishes 8.06% for the quarter beginning July 1, 2026 under Fla. Stat. §55.03. The statutory rate is selected when judgment is obtained and then adjusts each January 1 to the CFO rate then in effect until paid. A written contract or obligation can establish its own rate, and clerk-entered judgments under §§55.141, 61.14, 938.29, and 938.30 do not receive the annual adjustment. The official table also supplies daily factors and every distinct period since October 1, 1981. Verify the correct branch; not legal advice.
